name: rtfx-local
description: Full local rtfx.pro tooling: publish a folder, build output or zip from disk by path, with slash commands and a local MCP server

api_token.title: rtfx.pro API token (optional)
api_token.description: A scoped token from rtfx.pro > Dashboard > Integrations (scopes: read, publish). Leave empty to sign in with a browser instead (/rtfx-local:login).

endpoint.title: rtfx endpoint
endpoint.description: Base URL of your rtfx instance. Leave as is for rtfx.pro; change it only for a self-hosted artifacts-server (https only).
